description: Shared contract fixtures for protocol v1 requests. Each case: validate `message` under `context` and expect `expect`. `schemaValid` states whether `message` alone satisfies shared/schemas/request.v1.schema.json. Implementations may be stricter than the schema (e.g. the P-256 curve check), in which case schemaValid is true and expect.ok is false. Error precedence: protocol.* > command.unknown > auth.required > auth.permissionDenied > auth.clockSkew > auth.replay > confirm.required > command.invalidPayload.
